description: Translates a PDF or a scanned document / photo of one into another language and returns the same document as a PDF: layout, tables, logos and every number kept and checked. For payslips, bank statements, official and government letters, birth and marriage certificates, diplomas, school reports, contracts, leases and forms, e.g. for a visa, immigration, a bank or a school. Strong on right-to-left sources (Hebrew, Arabic), which it can also mirror into a left-to-right layout. Use when the user says 'translate this PDF / document / scan', 'keep the formatting / layout', 'give me back the PDF', or when a translation in chat lost the tables or layout. Give the document as `file` (a file the user attached) or `file_url` (an https link). Up to 3 pages per document. Takes 30-90 seconds; if it takes longer, returns an id for get_translation.

file.description: The document the user attached (ChatGPT file).

file_url.description: https link to the PDF or image, when no file is attached.

from.description: Source language. Leave out to detect it.

keep_logos.description: true = don't translate logos and wordmarks.

layout.description: keep = same layout as the original (default); ltr = mirror a right-to-left page (Hebrew, Arabic) into a left-to-right layout.

to.description: Target language, e.g. English, Spanish, German. Defaults to English.

name: translate_document
title: Translate a document and keep its layout
